evidence.quote: Founded in 1945, M&D Group - with its brands Meat&Doria and Hoffer Products - is today an independent multinational reality and a global reference point in the automotive aftermarket. Our catalogue, in continuous growth, exceeds 40,000 references || 11 warehouses 13 offices || Collaboration agreements with Car Makers, Tier1 and OEMs.
